rv.q: Liberace's life force is too great to be tamed.
It’s enormous fun to watch, and you have to take your hat off to its ambition.
It’s a bittersweet story, and another roaring success for Pitlochry Festival Theatre.

cn.t: Martin Sherman's meta-theatrical exploration of Liberace dazzles critics with Simon Russell Beale's flamboyant performance and Tim Hatley's award-worthy designs, delivering the showy bravura audiences expect from this creative team.
